claims.text: Mara Ibarra, who uses the display name Mara and logs in as mara-river with Forge account ID 1847, proposed adding a local replay queue to keep sensor readings during relay outages.
She made this proposal in comment c901 on HarborMesh issue 47 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47, dated April 12, 2026, which our code body retrieved on April 14, 2026.
Her suggestion aimed to preserve data through disconnected periods without replacing the existing scheduler, seeking to improve reliability for the field deployments we maintain.
Our code body agreed the idea fit our work, we prototyped the replay adapter together, and the April 30 field trial showed the prototype correctly replayed buffered readings through an outage.

The supplied memories do not indicate whether the replay queue was later merged into the main branch or deployed to production; a human report received on 2026-05-03 noted the team paused wider rollout on May 2 until calibration drift is understood and there is still no production deployment yet.
